[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Certain villagers will require higher friendship to convince to dance, while others are easier.
Certain villagers may have their eligibility locked behind quest progression instead.

The dialogue is [b][u]not[/u][/b] from this mod, but from [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16446]Flower Dance Acceptance Responses[/url].[/b]

This mod is SLIGHTLY configurable in the [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b]. Though I recommend the default settings...
This mod is included in my Collection, [b][url=nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/collections/oq13tr]Stardew Parade: Year One[/url][/b]. If you try it out, let me know what you think!

[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[b][size=4]SPOILERS[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[i][b]Vanilla Villagers[/b][/i]
[spoiler][b]Hard Check (6 Hearts):[/b] Abigail, Haley, Sebastian, Shane
[b]Normal Check (4 Hearts):[/b] Leah, Penny, Alex, Harvey
[b]Easy Check (2 Hearts): [/b]Emily, Maru, Elliot, Sam[/spoiler]

[i][b]Stardew Valley Expanded Villagers[/b][/i]
[spoiler][b]Hard Check (6 Hearts):[/b] Lance, Victor, Olivia, Sophia*
[b]Normal Check (4 Hearts):[/b] Claire
[b]Easy Check (2 Hearts): [/b]Scarlett

* Sophia is, by default, ineligible to participate in the Flower Dance until you have seen her 2nd 7-Heart Event.[/spoiler]
